name: X-53 Touring Rocket: the client spell row loses the flying-areas-only flag (#11300)
contract: #11300 reported 'You can't use that here.' (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_HERE) when summoning the X-53 Touring Rocket in Stonetalon Mountains. #10460 made the summon spell 75973 a ground mount by clearing SPELL_ATTR4_ONLY_FLYING_AREAS (0x04000000) in the server SpellInfo only. The stock client Spell.dbc row carries AttributesEx4 67108864, so the client refused the cast outside flying areas before the server sees it. The client's spell data now carries row 75973 with AttributesEx4 0 and keeps the client's Attributes 269582608 and AttributesEx6 131072. The rendered cast in game is not observed here.
